use sequences
fun X transform Scale
 Grid = X reshape # 2
 Shifted = Grid * Scale + 0.5
 return Shifted reshape #
end
sources.indexed:
use sequences
fun X transform Stride
 N = X len
 K = (0 till (N // Stride - 1)) * Stride
 Left = X K
 Right = X (K + Stride)
 return Right - Left
end

use sequences
fun X transform Scale
 Grid = X reshape # 2 1
 unpack Left Right = Grid axis 1
 Mid = (Left + Right) * 0.5
 Spread = (Left - Right) * Scale
 Out = concat Mid Spread axis 1
 return Out reshape #
end

fun X step Scale

 return Shifted reshape #

fun X transform Scale

 Count = 16

  A = A step Scale
  Count -= 1
 end
 return A
end
